title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Every keyboard shortcut the editor answers in its default view, with the key on a Mac and on Windows.
---

These are the keys the Keyboard shortcuts dialog lists. Open it in the editor with Help > Keyboard shortcuts, or press Cmd+/ (Ctrl+/ on Windows), and type in its search box to find a key. Every row is also a command in a menu, so Help > Search the menus finds it by name.

Turning on Tools > Advanced tools adds the keys of the commands behind it. See [Advanced tools](/docs/editor/advanced-tools).

## Common actions

| Action                                         | Mac                | Windows              |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | -------------------- |
| New slide                                      | Ctrl M             | Ctrl+M               |
| Undo                                           | Cmd Z              | Ctrl+Z               |
| Redo                                           | Cmd Y, Cmd Shift Z | Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z |
| Copy                                           | Cmd C              | Ctrl+C               |
| Paste                                          | Cmd V              | Ctrl+V               |
| Slideshow                                      | Cmd Enter          | Ctrl+F5              |
| Search the menus                               | Option /           | Alt+/, Alt+Z         |
| Last edit                                      | Cmd Option Shift H | Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H     |
| Assist                                         | Cmd J              | Ctrl+J               |
| Start from beginning                           | Cmd Shift Enter    | Ctrl+Shift+F5        |
| Open                                           | Cmd O              | Ctrl+O               |
| See version history                            | Cmd Option Shift H | Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H     |
| Print                                          | Cmd P              | Ctrl+P               |
| Cut                                            | Cmd X              | Ctrl+X               |
| Paste without formatting                       | Cmd Shift V        | Ctrl+Shift+V         |
| Delete                                         | Delete             | Delete               |
| Duplicate                                      | Cmd D              | Ctrl+D               |
| Select all                                     | Cmd A              | Ctrl+A               |
| Find and replace                               | Cmd Shift H        | Ctrl+H               |
| Link                                           | Cmd K              | Ctrl+K               |
| Keyboard shortcuts                             | Cmd /              | Ctrl+/               |
| Insert comment                                 | Cmd Option M       | Ctrl+Alt+M           |
| Hide the menus                                 | Ctrl Shift F       | Ctrl+Shift+F         |
| Find                                           | Cmd F              | Ctrl+F               |
| Find again                                     | Cmd G              | Ctrl+G               |
| Find previous                                  | Cmd Shift G        | Ctrl+Shift+G         |
| Save (every change is saved automatically)     | Cmd S              | Ctrl+S               |
| Open link                                      | Option Enter       | Alt+Enter            |
| Copy formatting of the selected text or shape  | Cmd Option C       | Ctrl+Alt+C           |
| Paste formatting of the selected text or shape | Cmd Option V       | Ctrl+Alt+V           |

## Filmstrip actions

| Action                    | Mac            | Windows         |
| ------------------------- | -------------- | --------------- |
| Duplicate slide           | Cmd D          | Ctrl+D          |
| Move slide up             | Cmd Up         | Ctrl+Up         |
| Move slide down           | Cmd Down       | Ctrl+Down       |
| Move slide to beginning   | Cmd Shift Up   | Ctrl+Shift+Up   |
| Move slide to end         | Cmd Shift Down | Ctrl+Shift+Down |
| Move to previous slide    | Up             | Page Up, Up     |
| Move to next slide        | Down           | Page Down, Down |
| Move focus to first slide | Home           | Home            |
| Move focus to last slide  | End            | End             |
| Select previous slide     | Shift Up       | Shift+Up        |
| Select next slide         | Shift Down     | Shift+Down      |
| Select first slide        | Shift Home     | Shift+Home      |
| Select last slide         | Shift End      | Shift+End       |

| Nudge by a larger increment           | Shift Up, Shift Down, Shift Left, Shift Right | Shift+Up, Shift+Down, Shift+Left, Shift+Right |
| Resize larger horizontally            | Ctrl Cmd B                                    | Ctrl+Alt+B                                    |
| Resize larger vertically              | Ctrl Cmd I                                    | Ctrl+Alt+I                                    |
| Resize smaller                        | Ctrl Cmd J                                    | Ctrl+Alt+J                                    |
| Resize larger                         | Ctrl Cmd K                                    | Ctrl+Alt+K                                    |

| Rotate clockwise by 15 degrees        | Option Right, Cmd Option Right                | Alt+Right, Ctrl+Alt+Right                     |
| Rotate counterclockwise by 1 degree   | Option Shift Left                             | Alt+Shift+Left                                |
